```{r}
# This code calculates the sum of elevated genes in the forebrain of the human, pig and mouse species.

forebrain_human <- sum(180,83,57,110)
forebrain_pig <- sum(109,157,31,45)
forebrain_mouse <- sum(55,185,60,98)

print(forebrain_human)
print(forebrain_pig)
print(forebrain_mouse)
```
The question being addressed is the elevated genes in the forebrain of the human, pig and mouse species.

The human species had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression with a total of 430 in the forebrain.
